_note: The campaign's continents on Tellus Nova (Content.continents(); D-418..D-422; Overworld plan row F3). Placeholder rows: the names, stages, order and Threat shares are ruled, the bonus ids are stand-ins until the director picks the bonuses (D-421: the plan's lists are proposals). In the globe's fixed sequence (D-420): Ostia Minor first, then the two lowest unconquered of Carthago..Neptunia are offered; the capital is last. id: the save's key (SaveFile campaign conquered/bonuses). stage: the growth stage the city plays at, an index of tuning growth.stages (0 young, 1 Behemoth, 2 Colossus; D-419). threat: Threat Level percent its conquest adds (D-422; the six sum to 80, in-mission noise adds the rest, capped at 99). bonuses: the three bonuses its conquest offers, the player keeps one (D-421); none for the capital. Each: id (the save's bonuses value) and scale, stat -> fraction added to that stat after upgrades (0.15 = +15%; picks on one stat add before multiplying; UpgradeTree.apply, plan row F4). Only Ostia Minor's three carry test scales; the rest are {} until the bonuses are picked. stage_words: the stages in game words by index, as the mission panel names them (plan row G5). capital: Aurelia, opened when the sixth conquest sets Threat to 100 (D-422).
